_doc: PORTAL-WIRE-B-1110 (vera/portal_follow.py). Owner 2026-11-10, verbatim: "That sample illustrates a result from a portal through which we can links to original sources. For promising sources, we should follow links recursively until we get to the original host of the original source doc". OD-1110-PORTALS-ALL: a portal's own text, abstract or snippet is never evidence. For the question's most relevant portal records (search results from OpenAlex, DuckDuckGo, INSPIRE, Wikipedia, preprint servers), links and identifiers are followed through METADATA lookups only (INSPIRE; OpenAlex only when auto_acquire.json arxiv_portal.openalex.enabled is true, which ships off pending the terms review) until vera/host_role.py says ORIGINAL or REPOSITORY_OF_RECORD. Portal pages are never fetched here: a PORTAL hop is followed only through an identifier in its link (DOI, arXiv id, OpenAlex W id). Every URL hop is checked with host_role.is_hop_allowed. The original URL or DOI is then handed to the unchanged acquisition gates (licence, relevance, robots/TDM, rate limits, the route allowlists). A DOI that is not a portal DOI is handed off as an identifier when no metadata lookup gives its original-host locations; the acquisition routes resolve it under their own per-hop host checks.
_calibration_note: Structural bounds, not decision thresholds; no live data has been measured for them (no fake-fixture tuning either). max_records_per_question 3 and max_refs_per_record 10 mirror arxiv_portal.max_records_per_call and max_refs_per_record so the follow-up adds at most as many candidates as the arXiv portal does and cannot crowd the 31-candidate cut (bounds.max_candidates_resolved); max_handoffs_per_record 11 = one published version + 10 references. max_hops_per_record 4 is the owner-task default hop cap (portal record -> identifier -> resolver/portal -> landing -> original). max_lookups_per_question 6 = 3 records x the two OpenAlex calls per record (owner, 2026-11-10). deadline_s 6 sits inside the acquisition discovery budget like the 5 s portal timeout. min_relevance_terms 1: a record must share at least one content word of the question in its title or snippet (the snippet is used for this judgement only, never as evidence). What would change them: 'autoacq portalfollow' log counts (records, hops, hop_cap, cycles, dead ends, hand-offs) and the admit rate of portal_follow candidates over live questions.
